jordan_acme: Hey team — hitting a blocker with SSO/SCIM during the POC. SCIM provisioning returns 409s and users aren't showing in the Console. I attached the JSON response in the portal screenshot.
maria_sales: thanks Jordan, looping in @sam_soleng (SE) and @ashley_security. Can you paste the exact SCIM error body and any IdP logs?
jordan_acme: here's the payload we get from Redwood SCIM endpoint: `{"status":409,"detail":"User with externalId already exists"}`. Also when trying the SAML sign-on -> API key flow we get `invalid_grant` on token exchange.
sam_soleng: 2 quick possibilities: (1) duplicate `externalId` from a previous failed sync, (2) IdP mapping isn't sending the attributes Redwood expects. By default we look for `externalId` (or `id`) + `userName` and `emails[0].value`. Any custom transforms on your side?
patrick_idp: we map `user.id` -> `urn:ietf:params:scim:schemas:core:2.0:User:externalId` and `user.email` -> `userName`. No transforms. We've provisioned users into other apps fine.
sam_soleng: okay. Can you confirm the SCIM POST/PUT body looks like this (example we expect):
```
POST /scim/v2/Users
{
  "userName": "jane.doe@example.com",
  "externalId": "12345",
  "name": {"givenName":"Jane","familyName":"Doe"},
  "emails": [{"value":"jane.doe@example.com","type":"work"}]
}
```
If `externalId` is missing or duplicates an existing record in Redwood from a previous POC, the endpoint returns 409. If your IdP is sending an `id` but not in the `externalId` claim path we need to adjust the mapping.
ashley_security: also check SAML assertion attributes. For the API key exchange we require `email` and `name` claims and the assertion `Audience` must match `https://auth.redwood.inference` (we sent this in the onboarding doc). Make sure there isn't a clock skew > 2 minutes; `invalid_grant` often means assertion or assertion signature mismatch.
maria_sales: Jordan — while we sort SSO/SCIM, would you accept a temporary Hosted API key scoped for the POC so you can keep testing? We can scope it to embeddings-only or generation read-only.
jordan_acme: yes that'll work. Please scope to embeddings-only and short TTL.
sam_soleng: Done — created scoped key `scoped-poc-embed-3Xk9` (embeddings-only), expires in 7 days. Sent via the secure channel. Also opened internal ticket INF-4821 to investigate duplicate-user cleanup and to add a small admin tool for clearing orphaned SCIM entries.
deploy-bot: Ticket INF-4821 created by sam_soleng. Assignee: eng-infra. Priority: P2. https://internal.redwood/tickets/INF-4821
maria_sales: next steps: (1) @sam_soleng to triage duplicate/cleanup INF-4821 and confirm SCIM id path, (2) @ashley_security to validate SAML assertion/audience/cert details, (3) @jordan_acme to confirm acceptance of the temporary key and re-run provisioning after we tweak mappings. Sync scheduled: tomorrow 10:00am PT. :calendar:
jordan_acme: confirmed, thanks everyone! :thumbsup:
